status: PROPOSAL for a future controlled length test - not narrated, not rendered, not approved
purpose: Arm B of a length test against the 51.7 s premium v1 (arm A). Same hook, same evidence, same visual system; only length and the number of causal steps change.
estimate: 91 words; at the v1 Edge read's measured overall rate (158 wpm including pauses) about 34.5 s. Must be re-measured from real narration before rendering.

E1.title: Rogers Commission Report, Vol. 1, Ch. III: The Accident

E2.title: Rogers Commission Report, Vol. 1, Ch. IV: The Cause of the Accident

E3.title: Rogers Commission Report, Vol. 1, Ch. V: The Contributing Cause of the Accident

removedFromV1: L2 smoke detail and the Fig. 14 insert (the joint animation carries the O-rings)
L6 'the smoke stopped' (keeps the 58 s jump without the explanation of the quiet minute)
L11 'their managers reversed that advice' (the short version keeps only the Commission's finding that the objection never reached the top officials; the reversal remains in the long version)

lines.text: Less than a second after liftoff, Challenger was already leaking.
evidence: E1: first smoke 0.678 s at the right SRB aft field joint
lines.shot: v1 S01 (NASA photo, ring on the smoke)

lines.text: That morning it was thirty-six degrees, and cold rubber springs back slowly.
lines.shot: v1 S04 (icicles, 36F) cut to v1.1 S05 (warm/cold: follows vs gap)

lines.text: So when ignition flexed a joint on the right booster, its O-rings couldn't keep up.
evidence: E2: gap opening begins upon ignition; O-rings may not follow the gap

lines.text: Fifty-eight seconds in, a flame broke through onto the fuel tank.
evidence: E1: flame 58.788 s; plume deflected onto the External Tank from 60.238 s
lines.shot: v1.1 S08 (E-207, held ring) then v1 S09 first half

lines.text: At seventy-three seconds, Challenger broke apart.
evidence: E1: breakup began at approximately 73 s

lines.text: All seven crew members were lost.
The night before, engineers had recommended not launching below fifty-three degrees.
evidence: E3: 'would not recommend a launch below 53 degrees Fahrenheit'

lines.text: NASA's top launch officials never heard it.
evidence: E3: the objections never reached the Levels I and II program officials
lines.shot: v1.1 S13 (engineers -> X -> top officials; managers node omitted)

lines.text: The seal failed in the cold. But the warning failed the night before.
evidence: editorial summary of E2 + E3, not a quote
lines.shot: v1.1 S15 (payoff on the opening photo; loop to frame 0)

testDesign: Use core/growth/experiments.js with variable 'length': control = long premium, variant = this script; 5+ Shorts per arm on comparable FR topics; primary metric engaged/views at 72 h, then % viewed and avg view duration. Decide only if the difference exceeds the within-arm spread; otherwise 'insufficient data'.
